• If the replacement code ever fails correctness checks, the score for that task is zero.

• GPT-4 produced valid, faster code for roughly two-thirds of the tasks, with a median speed-up of a little over 3× and occasional 50–100× wins when it recognised an opportunity to off-load work to vectorised NumPy/SciPy or to built-in C extensions.
